from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Disposition(BaseModel):
    """The main judgment or ruling outcome."""
    type: str | None = Field(description="High-level outcome type (e.g., 维持原判，改判，准许撤回)")
    text: str | None = Field(description="Verbatim excerpt of the final disposition")

class Fee(BaseModel):
    """Details about court costs mentioned in the document."""
    fee_type: str | None = Field(description="Type of fee (e.g., 二审案件受理费，一审案件受理费)")
    amount: float | None = Field(description="The fee amount in RMB")
    payer: str | None = Field(description="Who bears the fee (names or group description)")
    is_prepaid: bool | None = Field(description="Whether the fee was prepaid")

class Party(BaseModel):
    """A party mentioned in the case."""
    name: str | None = Field(description="Full name of the party")
    role: str | None = Field(description="Role (e.g., 上诉人，被上诉人，申请人)")
    is_appellant: bool | None = Field(description="Is this party the appellant")

class CaseInfo(BaseModel):
    """Identifiers related to the case."""
    case_number: str | None = Field(description="The case number string")
    court_name: str | None = Field(description="Court name if extractable")
    case_level: str | None = Field(description="Instance level (first, second, retrial)")

class SpecificIdentifier(BaseModel):
    """Unique factual details that distinguish this case."""
    label: str | None = Field(description="Type of identifier (e.g., compensation_amount, bank_account)")
    value: str | None = Field(description="The specific value")
    context: str | None = Field(description="Brief context")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    dispositions: list[Disposition]
    fees: list[Fee]
    parties: list[Party]
    case_info: list[CaseInfo]
    specific_identifiers: list[SpecificIdentifier]
